description: Create an X-Matrix element, or update one when element_id is given. Quadrants: north = 3-5 year vision, east = annual objectives, south = initiatives, west = KPIs. A west element should carry indicator_type so the completeness score can judge the leading/lagging balance. Aim for 3 to 5 elements per quadrant. Use status "draft" for a hypothesis the committee has not validated yet. Set visibility "internal" at creation for anything that must not leave the organization (named prospects, amounts, salaries), before any share or export. The initiative sheet and the KPI definition are written by upsert_initiative_sheet and set_kpi_definition.

due_date.description: Due date, ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). Pass an empty string to clear.

element_id.description: UUID of an existing element to update. Omit to create a new one.

external_ref.description: URL or key of the project implementing this in your execution tool (Linear, Jira, GitHub)

indicator_type.description: For west elements only: result = lagging (measures outcomes), performance = leading (measures the process producing them). Every objective should be tracked by at least one of each.

links.description: Links to third-party tools (an A3, a QRQC, a ticket, a document, a project number). Sending the list REPLACES the current one: read it first (get_matrix_data, search_ideas) and send it back with your additions; [] clears it.

ref.description: Free reference: a URL, a ticket or project number, a path

matrix_id.description: UUID of the matrix (default: the organization default matrix)

owner_id.description: UUID of the user who owns this element. Pass an empty string to clear.

parent_element_id.description: Cascade: UUID of the element of the PARENT matrix that this element deploys. Usual pattern: a parent annual objective (east) or initiative (south) becomes a north or east element of the level below. The matrix must have a parent matrix. Pass an empty string to remove the link.

quadrant.description: Quadrant of the element (required when creating)

title.description: Title of the element (required when creating)

visibility.description: "internal" keeps the element, and its correlations, off public share pages and external images: named prospects or clients, salaries, anything said in confidence. Default "shared". It does not restrict who reads it inside the organization.

name: upsert_element
